metadata.title: Banking Domain Data Analyst Interview Prep — Trailer
metadata.purpose: ~96s whole-book trailer for 'Banking Domain Data Analyst Interview Prep — US Industry Standards, 2026' (books/banking-data-analyst-interview-prep). Manim-rendered title cards + Kokoro (free) narration, compiled with ffmpeg. Beat 1 carries the compliance-required attribution line: Supriya introduces herself by name and states the video's topic.
metadata.clock: narration (Kokoro, local/free) — durations are word-count estimates until audio lock

beats.narration_text: Hi, I am Supriya and this video is about how a data analyst who already knows SQL and Python can close the banking-specific vocabulary gap that actually fails interviews. This is Banking Domain Data Analyst Interview Prep. The full loop, end to end.

card.copy: Banking Domain Data Analyst Interview Prep
card.sub: The full loop, end to end

beats.narration_text: Here's the thing nobody tells you. You can already write window functions and ship dashboards. Banking interviews fail you anyway — because nobody taught you the regulatory and risk vocabulary the business runs on.

card.copy: You don't fail for lack of skill.
card.sub: You fail not knowing the bank's own vocabulary.

beats.narration_text: This book closes that gap in six parts. The regulatory landscape. Regulation, risk, and governance. The modern banking data stack. SQL and Python on real banking data. Case, behavioral, and systems rounds. And a day-of reference to tie it together.
And every stage scores something different. A query that runs but you can't explain NIM or CECL is a weak answer. In the case round, framing the risk beats getting the number right.

card.copy: Each stage scores a different thing.

beats.narration_text: This guide is built for twenty twenty-six. Post-stress liquidity and capital metrics are back in interview conversation. CECL reserves. AML and fraud analytics are growing fast. And interviewers now ask how you use AI tools responsibly.

items: LCR & CET1 after the regional-bank stress

beats.narration_text: Every practice scenario inside is original. Invented banks, invented portfolios, written to drill the exact skills real banking loops test. Nothing copied from a question bank.

card.sub: Invented banks. Real skills. No question banks.

beats.narration_text: Fifteen chapters. One clear path from your first screen to the offer. Banking Domain Data Analyst Interview Prep.

card.sub: Banking Domain Data Analyst Interview Prep
